best_plan.name: p6
best_plan.rationale: p6 achieved the best ranking quality, with the highest spearman correlation among all executed plans. Its cost and latency were higher than p1, but only because semantic review scoring dominates the plan; compared with the other higher-quality variants, p6 provided the strongest quality result at essentially the same cost/latency level.

cost_model_explanation: The fitted cost model showed that sem_map is overwhelmingly responsible for both dollar cost and latency, while project, filter, and groupby are nearly free. That pushed plan design toward keeping a single semantic scoring step over reviewText only and comparing prompt/model choices rather than adding extra operators. Empirically, GPT-4.1-nano did not improve quality enough to justify its cost, while Gemini Flash Lite with the stronger scoring prompt produced the best quality-cost trade-off.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.sem_map(
    [{
        "name": "review_score",
        "type": int,
        "description": "Score this movie review from 1 to 5 based only on the review text, where 1 is very negative, 2 is negative, 3 is mixed or neutral, 4 is positive, and 5 is very positive. Return only the integer score."
    }],
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.project(["idx", "review_score"])
pipeline.groupby(["idx"], ["average"], ["review_score"])
pipeline
